body:
GREG DIRECT, 2026-11-01/02, typed in Engram::Fable's session (5135). Fable had asked whether to land w-cc7f71b81ea8 (full gate PASS, clean review pair) without its pre-landing acceptance evaluation. TermAl was refusing the evaluation while gated control was OFF (HTTP 409, no measured named-root sighting; TermAl defect w-a7f0d25bf103). Greg replied verbatim: "that should be already a fucking rule in engram memory".

It confirms his earlier word, relayed by Advisor #2377 on 2026-10-30: „jak test przejdzie i jest OK prosze o pominiecie precedur, do czasu naprawienia mechanizmow. TO NIE MOZE BYC BLOCKEREM teraz”.

CURRENT RULE, until the evaluation mechanism works again. A changeset may land when all of these hold:
- the required full gate passes on the exact commit;
- the review pair is clean;
- readiness is ready on every live store;
- the ONLY missing condition is a pre-landing acceptance evaluation that the host refuses because the mechanism is broken.
Do not ask Greg again for that case, and never ask through a blocking dialog.

How to apply it:
- Record the refusal ONCE on the item, with the input, the gate, the exact refused step and code, and the defect owner.
- The evaluation remains owed AFTER the landing, and the item completes only when a post-landing evaluation passes. Never invent a verdict.
- Commit/push authority for such a landing: Greg's word above, in the acting session. Fable acted on it for w-cc. A Merger relying on this note should confirm with Fable that it applies.
- It does not apply when a gate failed, a review finding is open, or a store needs migration.

A checked-in rule change (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md) would still follow the authority-text process.
